rejected_rule.statement: In a rei-vindicatio action, it is highly dangerous to adjudicate on an issue of prescription without first going into and examining the documentary title of the parties.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In Karunadasa vs Abdul Hameed 60 NlR 352, it was held that in a re-vindicatio action it is highly dangerous to adjudicate on a issue of prescription without first going in to and examining the documentary title of the parties.
